summary: Allocates and initializes a particle vertex buffer. Frees any existing descriptor and entry array, allocates a fresh descriptor (20 bytes, constructed by sub_54EB20) plus an entry array of 116*a3 bytes, zero-initializes the array, then copies per-particle position and secondary-vector data from the source buffer (a2) into the entries. Finally computes the maximum squared camera-to-particle distance across all entries (camera position read from the this+0x204 array) and stores its square root into the descriptor.

operations.description: If the descriptor pointer at this+0x1E0 is non-null AND its entry-array pointer at descriptor+0x8 is non-null, the old buffer must be torn down before reallocation.
LinkedNodeDestruction(this) is invoked on the old descriptor before freeing it.
FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the old descriptor pointer stored at this+0x1E0.
The descriptor pointer at this+0x1E0 is cleared to 0 after freeing the old buffer.
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(20) allocates a new descriptor block; if non-null the descriptor is constructed by sub_54EB20.
The new descriptor pointer is stored at this+0x1E0 and the descriptor's entry count is set from a3.
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(116 * a3) allocates the particle entry array (116 bytes per entry).
Each of the a3 entries is initialized by calling ShortComputation_eaf0 on the entry (entries advance by 29 dwords = 116 bytes).
The descriptor's entry-array pointer (descriptor+0x8) is set to the newly allocated array and the whole array is zeroed via memset(0, 116 * a3).

For each entry, source position and secondary-vector data is copied: entry+0x4/+0x8/+0xC receive position components, entry+0x1C/+0x20/+0x24 receive secondary components, entry+0x0 (flags) is set to 0 and entry+0x34 onwards is zeroed via memset(0, 0x40).

For each of the two sub-elements of every entry, computes the squared distance between the camera position (this+0x204 array, elements at +0xDC/+0xE0/+0xE4) and the particle position (entry +0x4/+0x8/+0xC), tracking the maximum squared distance.
The descriptor's first dword (descriptor+0x0) receives sqrt(max squared distance), the maximum camera-to-particle distance used for LOD culling.

unresolved: Exact role of the 0x1C/0x20/0x24 secondary vector components is not evidenced beyond 'copied from source entry'.
The descriptor count field at descriptor+0x4 is written (v6[1] = a3) but has no packet field evidence ref.
